### 📓 Docs Drift Check
Nothing in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **0** changed package(s)), so **this run has no opinion** about the docs.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **0** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6a35635a3385d74859186c271b306da0c999e6a7` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## 席位核对

L1 (L1-e) on head `b09dc558bdf08c33a84efcf06566e34ce8f99a98`, card #36409: **REWORK**. Two items are owed. Each is small, and neither changes product code.

**Owed**
1. **The new package branch of `saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata` has no pin.**
   - The body says the helper "now saves a new view into the app's package when the caller passes the app, as `createRuntimeMetadata` does". That is the only behaviour change in `runtime-metadata-persistence.ts`.
   - No test passes `ctx.app`. `objectViewViewSharing.test.tsx` passes `app: { packageId: null }` and pins the package-less options. `runtime-metadata-persistence.test.ts` and `ViewConfigPanel.pinnedDraftSave-36137.test.tsx` pass no app.
   - The live run does not say which package the shared view landed in. Showcase is installed, so the save should have gone through ensure-customization into `.custom`.
   - What to add, mocking the package doors the way the #35624 `createRuntimeMetadata` pins do:
     - a writable app package: the save names that package;
     - an installed app package: the save names the pair the ensure door returns;
     - an app with no resolvable package: the save names none;
     - in every case, `publish` and `reset` name no package (ADR-0146 D8);
     - a `type: 'dashboard'` call with an app ignores it.
2. **The defect named in the Acceptance notes needs a card.**
   - "Manage views, the view settings panel and the Create View dialog still gate on `isAdmin` alone". That is a shipped defect, found and left untouched: an organization administrator is offered those controls and the server refuses them.
   - File it (the seat may) and name `#N` on that line.

**Read and accepted**
- **Shape** (`l1-face.mjs --pr 36398`): open, draft, base `main`, `Fixes #36409`, `Clause-②: yes (widening)` (two new `@object-ui/i18n` keys), `Metadata-protocol: none`. Gates at this head: 63 success, 11 expected skip, 0 failed.
  - The face flags `changeset` for `@objectstack/rest`. That touch is a single `*.test.ts`. `packages/rest/tsconfig.json` excludes tests and `files[]` is `dist`, so nothing ships and no entry is owed.
- **`Fixes` is right.** The PR covers the card's three To-do items, and item 4 (no 设为共享 / 取消共享) holds: the row actions are gone.
- **Acceptance.**
  - Measured live at `a0dfe1a4`: an administrator creates a shared view, and a member sees it at once and is offered no Shared choice.
  - Not live: the organization-administrator leg (no persona is seeded). Accepted as a deviation. The gate is `useCanAuthorMetadata`, the established server-sourced hook (`/auth/me/permissions`) that already gates HomePage, SidebarAppMenu and the studio design gate. It is pinned by the unit test and its ablation (`return isAdmin;` turns it red), and by the server pin.
- **403 pin.** It is driven with the shipped permission sets (`securityDefaultPermissionSets`), not hand-written grants. It asserts `status` 403, `code` FORBIDDEN, and zero protocol calls on save, publish and delete. The `admin_full_access` control reaches each door. That meets the ADR-0112 envelope rule.
- **Create, shared.** Same `buildAddViewSpec` and `viewEnvelope` as the old `handleViewCreate`. It saves with the first-write pin (`ifNoneMatch: '*'`), publishes, and navigates without `?preview=draft`, which is right now that the view is published. A `'pending-draft'` outcome is said (`shareNameTaken`). A thrown refusal goes through `viewSaveRefusalText` and publishes nothing.
- **Gone-view notice.** `absent` is set only on a `not_found` verdict, and the existing `missedViewName` guards still apply (personal views loading, preview drafts). The toast fires once per name. Just after a create, the probe of the new name answers found, not `not_found`, so a fresh shared view does not raise the notice.
- **Composes with #36405** (`f0750e0d`, queued). Main plus #36405 plus this head merges cleanly, `runtime-metadata-persistence.ts` included.
  - The new branch keys on `type === 'view'`, so #36405's `saveDashboardInPlace` passes no app and is unaffected.
  - #36405's `boundToPackage` names `?package=` on save, publish and reset for a dashboard with two holders. This branch names it on the save only, which is right for a new name with one holder.
- **Sentences, checked one by one.** The changeset (offered only with `manage_metadata`; saved and published in one act; a refused save publishes nothing; the gone-view notice once; two keys under `view.switcher`) and the `views.mdx` paragraph are true of the diff. The 11 locale packs carry both keys.
- **Skills-docs.** Not owed: no published skill describes this surface.

A delta ACCEPT on the next head follows if it adds only the pins and the body line.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `b09dc558bdf08c33a84efcf06566e34ce8f99a98`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #36409 body and its three comments (claim 7077798297, triage 7078044064, os-dev-report 7078871713); card #36371 body and its comments, rulings 7076659420 and 7077377066 included; PR #36398 body and its one comment (the docs drift bot, no earlier review record); the net diff against main at merge base ff601499; the 74 check-runs on this head. Nothing was built, tested or re-run. The one local command beyond reading was a read-only `git merge-tree` of this head with the #36405 head, to answer the composition question below.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Server accept set: unchanged. Right.** The only file under `packages/` is `packages/rest/src/meta-write-door-capability-enumeration.test.ts`. No server code moves. The new describe pins what the server already does: with the shipped `member_default` and `member_default` plus `organization_admin` grants, the view's save, publish and delete answer `403 FORBIDDEN` before the protocol is reached; `admin_full_access` reaches all three. The save door asks `metaSaveVerdict`, which is `metaWriteCapabilityVerdict` on `manage_metadata` or `isSystem`. No gate moved to the client only, and no refusal changed. `@objectstack/plugin-security` is already a dependency of `@objectstack/rest`, so the new import adds no edge.
- **Client gate reads the server's capability. Right.** `mayShareViews(isAdmin, canAuthorMetadata)` takes `useCanAuthorMetadata()`, which asks `hasCapabilities(['manage_metadata'])`, the same capability the save door asks. `ObjectView.tsx` now passes `canCreateShared: canShareViews` in place of `isAdmin`. The Console offers less than the server accepts (a `manage_metadata` holder who is not `isAdmin` is not offered Shared). That is the maintainer's rule on #36371, and it is presentational only.
- **Publish at once: client sequence only. Right.** `createShared` now goes through `saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata`: a draft save under the first-write pin, then a publish of that one item, and a discard of the draft when the publish is refused. Both doors already exist and are pinned above. Before this head the same create went through `createRuntimeMetadata` and left a draft. What the server accepts is the same.
- **Save path and #36405. Composes.** This head adds `packageId` to the save in `saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata` only when `type === 'view'` and the caller passes `ctx.app`; the publish and the reset name no package and rely on ADR-0146 D8, as `createRuntimeMetadata` already does since #35624. The only caller that passes an app is the new `createShared`; `handleViewSaveAndPublish` passes none and is unchanged. #36405 (head f0750e0d) appends `saveDashboardInPlace` and `boundToPackage` after the function and changes nothing inside it. Its calls are all `dashboard`, so the view branch never runs for them and the bound package is the only package on its save, publish and reset. If a later view caller used `boundToPackage` with an app, the bound package would still win on save (it is spread last) and match on publish and reset. `git merge-tree` of the two heads is clean.
- **Public surface: two i18n keys. Right.** `view.switcher.shareNameTaken` and `view.switcher.viewGone` are added in all eleven locale packs of the published `@object-ui/i18n`. `MetaItemRefusalReading.absent` and the changed `saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata` live in `@object-ui/app-shell`, which is private and exports neither from its index. Nothing is removed or renamed.
- **Metadata protocol: none. Right.** No spec file, no metadata key, value or type an author can write.
- **PR body and changeset claims: they match the code.** The make-shared and unshare row actions are gone from the net diff. "Existing callers pass none" holds. "A refused save publishes nothing" holds: the publish runs only after the save resolves, and the new test pins it. The keys are in every pack. Check-runs on this head: 63 success, 11 skipped, 0 failed, the same figures the report gives.

### ② Semver level

The changeset `.changeset/shared-view-create-for-metadata-admins.md` names `@object-ui/app-shell` patch and `@object-ui/i18n` patch, and carries `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial, as the PR body does. AGENTS.md ties the level to the kind: `none` takes patch, and a widening that is not a protocol change ships patch. The two keys are a widening of the i18n packs, so `yes (widening)` is the right line. No changeset is owed for `@objectstack/rest`, which gains a test only. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty.
- `security_findings`: none. I found none either.
- Out-of-scope flag: Manage views, the view settings panel and the Create View dialog still gate on `isAdmin` alone, so an organization administrator without `manage_metadata` is offered them and refused `403`. The card names only the Shared choice, so this does not block this PR. It is the same fault class as the card and it has no carrier. Escalated to the seat: file it as a card.
- SQL push-down: the diff adds no id materialisation and no in-app join. It is client UI, one client helper and a server test. Nothing to push down.
- Noted, not graded, outside the contract face: the sharing test pins `mayShareViews` as a function, not the `canCreateShared` wiring in `ObjectView.tsx`, and the gone-view notice and the `shareNameTaken` path have no unit pin (the notice has the live screenshot at a0dfe1a4). Under a walled deployment the save door also asks `walledCatalogRefusal`, which the Console gate does not read; the server still refuses there, and that is outside this card.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

## 席位核对

L1 (L1-e) delta on head `6554451104d5da29e53ab3f6d93b77b3c4e035c1`, card #36409: **ACCEPT**. This supersedes REWORK 7078972087 (head `b09dc558`).

- **No non-test file moved.** `b09dc558..65544511` is one commit and two files, both tests:
  - `objectViewViewSharing.test.tsx`, +18/−1
  - `runtime-metadata-persistence.saveAndPublishIntoApp-36409.test.ts`, new, +175
  
  Product code, the changeset, the docs and the locales are byte-identical to the head the L2 PASS 7078996456 read, so that PASS carries.
- **Owed item 1, closed.** The new file drives `saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata` through the real package doors (fetch-level) and pins every case asked for:
  - a writable app package: the save names it, the only door asked is `GET /packages`, and no pair is asked for;
  - an installed package: the save names the ensure door's `com.example.crm.custom`;
  - an unlisted package, and no app: the save names none;
  - publish, and the discard after a refused publish, name no package (ADR-0146 D8);
  - a non-view type ignores the app, with no package door asked.
  
  The added `shareNameTaken` pin covers the `'pending-draft'` outcome: told so, reported unsaved, nothing published, no refresh, no navigation.
- **Owed item 2, closed.** #36448 is filed (open): "Manage views, view settings and Create View are offered on isAdmin alone…". The Acceptance-notes line names it as the carrier.
- **Gates at this head:** 62 success, 11 expected skip, 0 failed, mergeable `clean`. The one `cancelled` row, PR-body guards 137207970474, is superseded on this same head by a `success` run (137208108864, 12:28:24Z) that the body edit triggered. It is not a red.
- Everything else in 7078972087 stands as read, including the composition with #36405.
